## Observation
On 2026-11-19 at about 20:57 PST (load average 42.97/43.57/41.22 on the shared agent host), a targeted pytest run in worktree fix-test-git-maint-detach (73 tests, -n 4) reported 72 passed and 1 error: tests/unit/test_topology_template_upkeep_guard.py::test_a_partially_pinned_repository_is_still_refused errored in teardown with subprocess.TimeoutExpired from tests/_isolation.py head() (git -C <worktree> rev-parse HEAD, 5 s watchdog, re-sampled GIT_PROBE_ATTEMPTS times). The test body passed. The same error appears 11 times across the 5 sandboxed overnight make verify logs of Nov 19-20 (always `rev-parse HEAD`, never the session's `status --porcelain`).

Closed bug dominating-removable-monkfish measured the same probe (p99 2.08 s, max 3.30 s under 18 processes x 100 probes).

## Root cause (verified)
The autouse `_no_repo_commits` guard (tests/conftest.py) samples the checkout's HEAD by STARTING a `git rev-parse HEAD` process in setup and in teardown of every test (about 43,000 process starts per `make verify`). Each start is bounded at GIT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5 s with 3 attempts, and the last timeout is raised by design. On a host too loaded to start a process within 5 s three times, a passing test errors. CI runners under load can hit the same thing.

Deterministic reproduction (Nov 20 2026, origin/main ebd2a68a451): a PATH `git` shim that sleeps 6 s before any `rev-parse HEAD` makes `pytest tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py::test_the_budget_is_still_a_real_hang_guard` report `1 error` (TimeoutExpired after 5 seconds, 15.75 s) every run, although the test passes.

## Approach
Remove the process start from the per-test HEAD sample instead of widening a bound: read HEAD from the git files, which is what `git rev-parse HEAD` does, and keep git as the authority for anything unusual.
- `tests/_isolation.py`: new `_read_head_from_files(root)`. It locates the git dir (`<root>/.git` directory, or the `gitdir:` file of a linked worktree plus its `commondir`), reads `HEAD`, follows `ref: <name>` up to 5 hops (per-worktree refs `refs/bisect/`, `refs/worktree/` and `refs/rewritten/` from the worktree git dir, all others from the common dir), and falls back to `packed-refs` for a packed ref. It returns an object id only when it has a 40- or 64-hex id; otherwise it returns `None`. It also returns `None` when `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_COMMON_DIR` or `GIT_WORK_TREE` is set, when the common dir has a `reftable` directory, or on any OSError. `head()` uses the reader first and the existing bounded, re-sampled git probe only on `None`, so unborn branches, non-repos and unknown layouts behave exactly as before, and a stuck probe there still fails loudly.
- `porcelain()` (2 starts per session, never seen to time out) is unchanged.
- No product code, config key, environment variable or flag changes.

## Scope
- `tests/_isolation.py`
- `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py`

## Testing
In `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py`:
- The reader matches `git rev-parse HEAD` on a branch, after `git pack-refs --all` (no loose ref left), on a detached HEAD, and in a linked worktree with its own branch.
- The reader returns `None` for an unborn branch (and `head()` then still returns `None` through git) and when `GIT_DIR` is set.
- `test_commit_guard_fails_explicitly_when_head_times_out` (real conftest on this checkout with every `rev-parse HEAD` stalled) becomes `test_real_commit_guard_reads_head_without_starting_git`: the passing nested test now passes and the stalling shim is never invoked for HEAD. This is the regression test for this bug.
- The loud-failure contract moves to `test_commit_guard_fails_explicitly_when_the_head_probe_times_out`, which forces the probe path (reader patched to `None`) and still requires `TimeoutExpired`. The two existing in-process probe tests (transient-stall re-sample, patched-sleep independence) also patch the reader to `None` so they keep testing the probe.
- Reproduction after the change: the 6 s `rev-parse HEAD` shim run gives `1 passed`, recorded here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Under the 6 s `rev-parse HEAD` shim the passing test errors before the change and passes after, runs recorded on this ticket.
- [x] The guard reads HEAD without starting git for a plain repository or linked worktree, with reader-versus-git equivalence tests for a branch, a packed ref, a detached HEAD and a linked worktree.
- [x] A stuck git probe on the fallback path still fails explicitly, covered by a test.
- [x] `make verify` passes on the change, and Gerrit gives Verified +1. (slot make verify of 840c705c27b: rc 0, 21745 + 231 passed; Windows sweep 44992822827 on the change: 20624 passed, 0 failed; Gerrit 3506 PS4 LLM-Review +1, Verified +1; merged 37b70ddc539. PS2's Verified -1 was the .rebar/gate_runs leak, fixed by coexistent-unclear-icefish, 2fdb8e0d7c7.)
